## The problem

What are you trying to accomplish that Order does not currently support? Describe the user workflow and outcome, not only a proposed implementation.

## Why the current behavior is insufficient

What happens today, and why does that block or weaken the workflow?

## Proposed direction

If you have one, describe it separately from the problem statement.

## Scope check

Order governs controlled work through its canonical lifecycle, authority, architecture, contracts, and verification model. Requests that materially change those boundaries require upstream design/governance treatment before implementation.
